L'Uit et l'Artci renforcent les capacités en SIG et gestion des données en Côte d'Ivoire

2026-09-27 Patrick N'Guessan (FratMat) GIS, SIG, QGIS, PostgreSQL-PostGIS, GeoServer, UIT, ARTCI, Côte d'Ivoire, Africa-BB-Maps, broadband mapping, geospatial training, Abidjan
Read the source article

Quick summary

The International Telecommunication Union (UIT) and Côte d'Ivoire's telecommunications regulator ARTCI organized a sub-regional GIS training in Abidjan (September 21-25, 2026) as part of the Africa-BB-Maps initiative, teaching experts from three countries to use QGIS, PostgreSQL-PostGIS, and GeoServer for broadband infrastructure mapping.

Key takeaways

  • UIT and ARTCI organized a sub-regional GIS training at Capitol Hôtel, Abidjan, September 21-25, 2026
  • The training is part of the Africa-BB-Maps initiative, co-piloted by UIT and funded by the EU through the "Global Gateway" strategy
  • Participants came from Côte d'Ivoire, Benin, and Burundi, plus representatives from ARTAO (Association of West African Telecommunications Regulators)
  • Technical tools covered include QGIS, PostgreSQL-PostGIS databases, and GeoServer platform
  • The training followed a foundational session held in Cotonou, Benin, in June 2026
  • Objective: enable participants to map existing internet infrastructure locations and identify areas needing network improvements
  • ARTCI has several years of expertise with its online cartography tool "cartodonnees.artci.ci"
